about_the_game:
Borderless Gaming Resizer (BGR) gives you full control over how your games* and applications appear on your screen.

Remove borders, resize windows to custom dimensions, position them exactly where you want and save your settings so they can be auto-applied later! Perfect for Multitaskers, Ultrawide users, streamers and anyone looking to tidy up their workspace.

Features

  • Borderless Mode - Remove borders and title bars for a clean windowed experience. Either Fullscreen or a resolution of your choosing!

  • Favorite Profiles - Save individual window configurations (size, position, screen) and create multiple profiles per app.

  • Auto-Apply on Launch - Automatically restores your saved/favorited layout when the app starts.

  • Multi-Monitor Support - Move and size windows across different screens easily.

  • Custom Hotkeys - Quickly toggle between borderless and bordered mode.

  • Lightweight & Non-Intrusive - Runs quietly in the background with minimal resource use.

  • Fully documented - BGR is fully documented to help you get started. Feeling stuck after reading the documentation? Join the Discord for support!

* Some older games might not work correctly due to how their rendering of windows is handled. This is a known issue with Unreal Engine 3 games.
